summary_zh: 今日三則報導聚焦同一事件：中國車企大舉赴泰國設廠，中國電動車在泰市占率四年內從趨近於零升至逾八成（一則報導為85%）。這顯示中資車廠正快速在泰落地，與TH華商製造業的布局動向直接相關。今日無新增或延續的痛點資料。
summary_en: All three items cover one story: Chinese automakers are building plants in Thailand en masse, and Chinese EVs' Thai market share rose from near zero to over 80% (one report says 85%) in four years. This is relevant to Chinese-owned manufacturers in Thailand. No pain data today.

items.title: 泰國開大門代價 中國電動車市占飆85％
items.summary_zh: 《紐約時報》報導，中國車企大舉赴泰設廠，中國電動車在泰市占率四年內從趨近於零升至逾八成。
items.summary_en: The New York Times reports that Chinese carmakers are building plants in Thailand, and Chinese EVs' market share there rose from near zero to over 80% in four years.

items.title: 泰國開放中國電動車進口 紐時：所付代價超乎預期
items.summary_zh: 中國汽車製造商大舉前往泰國設廠，中國電動車市占率四年間從趨近於零暴增至逾8成。
items.summary_en: Chinese automakers are moving in large numbers to build plants in Thailand, and Chinese EVs' market share rose from near zero to over 80% in four years.

items.title: 美媒：泰國向中國電動車開大門，如今正付出代價
items.summary_zh: 美媒報導中國車企大舉赴泰設廠，中國電動車市占率四年來從幾近於零升至85%。
items.summary_en: A US media report says Chinese carmakers are building plants in Thailand, and Chinese EVs' market share rose from near zero to 85% in four years.
